description_en: Modifies the configuration of a specified application
description_zh: 修改指定应用的配置信息
name: UpdateApplication

parameters.help_en:
The callback URLs.

Separate multiple URLs with semicolons (;)
parameters.help_zh:
回调地址。

输入多个时，以英文分号（;）分隔
parameters.name: new_redirect_uris

parameters.help_en:
The permission scope of the application.

For more information about the valid values and descriptions of application permission scopes, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93693.html. You can also call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187206.html to query the permission scopes supported by different application types.

Separate multiple permission scopes with semicolons (;).

The new permission scopes overwrite the existing permission scopes. For example, if the existing permission scope is `/acs/ccc` and you set the new permission scope to `/acs/alidns`, the effective permission scope is `/acs/alidns`. If you want to add `/acs/alidns` to the existing scope, set the new permission scope to `/acs/ccc;/acs/alidns`
parameters.help_zh:
应用权限范围。

关于应用权限范围的取值和描述，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93693.html。您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187206.html获取不同应用类型支持的应用权限范围。

输入多个应用权限范围时，以英文分号（;）分隔。

新的应用权限范围会覆盖原来的应用权限范围。例如：如果原来的应用权限范围是`/acs/ccc`，新设置的应用权限范围为`/acs/alidns`，则最终生效的应用权限范围为`/acs/alidns`。如果您想在原有范围基础上新增`/acs/alidns`，请将新的应用权限范围设置为`/acs/ccc;/acs/alidns`
parameters.name: new_predefined_scopes

parameters.help_en:
The required permission scopes of the application.

You can set one or more scopes in `RequiredScopes` as required. After a scope is set as required, it is selected by default and cannot be cleared when a user authorizes the application.

If you also specify `NewPredefinedScopes`, the scope list of the application is reset by using `NewPredefinedScopes` first, and then the required scopes are configured by using this parameter.

Separate multiple permission scopes with semicolons (;).

The new required scopes overwrite the existing required scopes.

If a scope specified in `RequiredScopes` is not included in `PredefinedScopes`, the required scope does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
必选的应用权限范围。

您可以将`RequiredScopes`中设置的一个或多个范围设为必选，设为必选后，当用户进行应用授权时，必选范围默认选中且不可取消。

如果您同时传入了`NewPredefinedScopes`，则会先通过`NewPredefinedScopes`重新设置应用的范围列表，再通过本参数进行范围是否必选的设置。

输入多个应用权限范围时，以英文分号（;）分隔。

新的必选范围会覆盖原来的必选范围。

如果您设置的`RequiredScopes`项不在`PredefinedScopes`的范围内，则该项必选范围不生效
parameters.name: new_required_scopes

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether an application secret is required. Valid values:

true
false

For WebApp and ServerApp applications, this value is forcibly set to true and cannot be modified.
For NativeApp applications, this value can be set to true or false. If not specified, the default value is false. Because such applications often run in untrusted environments and cannot effectively protect application secrets, do not set this value to true unless you have a specific need. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93697.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要应用密钥。取值：

true
false

对于WebApp和ServerApp类型的应用，该值会被强制设置为true，不支持修改。
对于NativeApp类型的应用，可以设置为true或false，如不设置，默认为false。由于此类应用往往运行在非可信环境，无法有效保护应用密钥，因此建议您如无明确需要，不要设置为true。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93697.html
parameters.name: new_secret_required

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the access token.

Valid values: 900 to 10800. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh:
访问令牌有效期。

取值范围：900~10800。单位：秒
parameters.name: new_access_token_validity

parameters.help_en:
The validity period of the refresh token.

Valid values: 7200 to 31536000. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh:
刷新令牌有效期。

取值范围：7200~31536000。单位：秒
parameters.name: new_refresh_token_validity

parameters.help_en:

false: Not allowed
parameters.help_zh:

true：允许。

false：不允许
